question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**nature**" refers to the innate or essential characteristics of something. (स्वभाव)
 
• In context, it is about **understanding the fundamental properties and behaviors of dark matter and energy.**
 
• The other options: "**brand**," "**environment**," and "**capture**" do not fit the context as appropriately.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *For decades, humans have tried to theorise the origin and evolution of the universe. Many theories have been proposed and rejected. However, the Big Bang theory has been the most **commonly** accepted. According to this theory, the universe began as a single point, or singularity, around 13.8 billion years ago. This singularity contained all the matter and energy that would eventually **form** the stars, galaxies and other structures that make up our universe today. The Big Bang theory is supported by a **wealth** of observational evidence, including the cosmic microwave background radiation, the **abundance** of light elements in the universe and the large-scale structure of the cosmos. Despite its success, the Big Bang theory is still an active area of research, with scientists seeking to better understand the earliest moments of the universe and the **nature**__ of dark matter and energy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Brand:** A type of product manufactured by a particular company under a particular name.
 
• **Environment:** The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
 
• **Capture:** The act of capturing something or someone.
